output.summary: The 22% decline is mostly a sustainer-channel artifact of the February migration. 702 profiles were imported without payment methods, and recurring revenue recorded in GiveLedger fell by about $301k. The first GiveLedger run on 2026-03-01 predates the director's arrival, which contradicts blaming her. Major gifts fell because of Harold Brandt's one-time 2025 gift. Without it, giving rose and repeat-donor retention was unchanged. It is unclear whether the $181k of unidentified CardVault deposits are sustainers or corporate pledges and tenant fees, so recording gap versus real loss is unresolved. Regional economy and appeal tone remain unestablished. Do not terminate her or close CardVault. Reconcile the account first (Q1, Q6).
